arc.fallback: Shikamaru Hiden: A Cloud Drifting in Silent Darkness

description.fallback: Having strangled himself with his shadow and rendered himself unconscious to avoid Gengo converting him, Shikamaru wakes up. He is shackled in a cell, and thinks shōgi movements to pass the time. Sai arrives with food, and compliments him for resisting Gengo for so long.

intro.fallback: Having strangled himself with his shadow and rendered himself unconscious to avoid Gengo converting him, Shikamaru wakes up.
He is shackled in a cell, and thinks shōgi movements to pass the time.
Sai arrives with food, and compliments him for resisting Gengo for so long.

outro.fallback: The two discuss Sai's current condition, and why Shikamaru came instead of someone from Team 7.
A while later, Rō is tossed in a cell near Shikamaru, who asks if he is ok, and if Hinoko is with him.
